collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The old crew leader wants their own child to take over, but another fisher is better: choose by family, or by skill.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has led the fishing crews for years and wants (subject.his/her) child, (friend), to take over. But everyone knows (third) is the better fisher and the better leader. (friend) knows it too, and is miserable about it. The crews must decide. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The crews follow custom and choose (friend). (friend) leads well enough, and quietly asks (third) for advice before every hard decision. The crews know who really leads. (subject) is proud and does not notice.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The crews choose (third). (subject) is hurt and stays away from the beach for a week. (friend) is the first to congratulate (third), with obvious relief. (subject) comes round, slowly.
